cohort: 2,270 singleton pregnancies with doppler sonography of middle cerebral artery (MCA) and umbilical artery (UA) performed up to 9 weeks before delivery
finding: A pathological cerebroplacental ratio (CPR ≤ 1.0) is associated with lower APGAR scores, lower gestational age at delivery, and a higher rate of cesarean section.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was significantly higher in the group of patients with pathological CPR, and multiple regression analysis showed significantly improved umbilical cord pH at delivery when cesarean section was performed.
